_comment: MUTATION TESTING. Stryker deliberately breaks the code (flips a >= to a >, a && to an ||, deletes a branch) and then runs the tests. If the tests still pass, that mutant SURVIVED — and a surviving mutant is a line of code no test actually protects. We shipped two mint-killing bugs past 77 green evals; coverage said we were fine. Coverage measures which lines RAN. Mutation score measures which lines are actually GUARDED. Scoped to the modules whose wrong answer becomes a false claim on a legal document. THRESHOLD RAISED TO 70 after the second pass: prose.js 47->89%, url-safe.js 37->67%, total 41->76%. The score may not regress below 70 again.

commandRunner.command: node eval/properties.test.js && node eval/boundaries.test.js && node eval/one-door.test.js && node eval/host-anchoring.test.js
